class.name: OcgAspectGradientbackground
class.brief_description: This class allows the definition of a window gradient background.
class.description: ! This class allows the definition of a window gradient background.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a window gradient background. Default color is Quantity_NOC_BLACK. Default fill method is Aspect_GradientFillMethod_None.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a window gradient background with two colours.

method.name: SetColors
method.description: Modifies the colours of the window gradient background.

method.name: Colors
method.description: Returns colours of the window gradient background.

method.name: BgGradientFillMethod
method.description: Returns the current gradient background fill mode.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
